description: Telangana government is betting big on AI to grow IT exports from $30bn to $200bn by 2030. Plans include hosting a global AI summit in 2024 and creating an AI city in Hyderabad. Learn more about their strategy here!
body_lead: HYDERABAD: In an audacious plan to grow IT exports from around $30bn to $200bn by 2030, Telangana govt is betting big on AI. For starters, Telangana govt, which is keen on making the state Indiaâs AI capital, plans to host a global AI summit in Sept 2024. The summit, which was originally planned for July this year, will see govt also unveil its mega plans for an AI city spread over 200 acres on the outskirts of Hyderabad, top officials in IT & industries minister D Sridhar Babuâs office told TOI.
